home.welcomeText: Footsteps from the center of Verbier, Shed. HOTEL offers everything you need and nothing you don't. Renovated and rebranded in 2022 by three Swedish friends, the building now houses a vibrant, intimate sportique hotel with spacious rooms, a stone-baked pizza restaurant, a bold feel at home energy, and a personal team that caters to your most spontaneous requests.
home.stayWithUsText: Our selection of 16 newly renovated rooms feature contemporary comfort in an alpine-scandi setting. In airy spaces, abstract art and eccentric books co-exist with luxurious duvets, while Tom Dixon carpets and views of craggy mountains create a contrast between industrial landscapes and nature.
home.shedGroupText: It all started with a dream about turning our strong gastronomic affinity into passion projects.
home.comeRambleText: Shed. HOTEL welcomes everyone to step into comfortable living with a youthful and personal touch. It's your holiday home where you sleep like a log, eat like De Niro and get treated like family.

rooms.title: Our Rooms
rooms.intro: With categories that cater to everyone's demands, all our newly renovated rooms feature ultra-comfy beds, desks for your remote work, smart TVs, views over the mountain peaks, eccentric books and curated artworks.

explore.title: Explore
explore.intro: Verbier's potential as a ski resort was not discovered until 1925 when a group of mountaineers hiked up 15km for the sole purpose of skiing back down again. Today, the place is one of the world's foremost freeride paradises, equally down to earth and out of this world. Explore the place where ski bums, families and celebs slalom, eat and paraglide in harmony.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: With a personal approach to service, everyone at Shed. HOTEL is at your disposal to ensure that even your most spontaneous requests are met when booking your next stay with us. Just call or email us with any enquiries.

policy.title: Shed. HOTEL POLICY
policy.intro: We strive to provide our guests with an exceptionally clean, safe, and friendly hotel experience. The following Hotel Policy/House Rules have been established based on industry standards, management and operational procedures, and our personal experience of owning and operating the Shed. HOTEL. These Hotel Policy/House Rules are considered a part of our reservation agreement with you. As our hotel guest, by reading and signing your hotel registration you are agreeing to abide by all of our Hotel Policy/House Rules, terms and conditions, and procedures. These Hotel Policy/House Rules are presented here to help promote our guests' safety and enjoyment and to ensure that each guest is aware of the understandings between the Shed. HOTEL and the guest.

When our subcontractors' servers are located abroad, we ensure that they are set up in a state where the legislation with regard to data protection is equivalent to the FDPL and the GDPR and that our subcontractors apply organizational and technical measures that comply with both the latter.

We would nonetheless like to draw your attention to the fact that it is impossible to guarantee complete protection and we suggest you apply good practices in order to contribute to the security of your data.
terms.storageText: We will store the data of a personal nature in our systems for as long as is required for the planned processing. When processing is complete, your data is destroyed.
terms.cookiesText: Our site uses cookies and plugins which may tend to record data automatically. Using them makes browsing the site more pleasant by improving its ergonomics based on the data collected. This data may also be used for statistical purposes, analyzing the behavior of internet users and geo-localization with the aim of personalizing our sales offer. When you browse our site, the computer you are using dialogues with a server which provides it with all the required resources by automatically recording every operation in a specific file in which the computer used is identified by its IP address. This is how the browser you use sends us certain standard data, notably about the browser used and its functionalities, the operating system of the computer, tablet or smartphone used, third-party sites (such as Facebook) from which you may have connected as well as the dates and times our site was accessed. This data and especially the IP address from which you are connected do not allow us to identify you by name. Should you open a page of our website containing one social media plugins such as Facebook, your internet browser will establish a direct connection with the social network server. The content of the plugin is directly transmitted by the social network concerned to your internet browser and incorporated to the web page by the latter. Thanks to the inclusion of cookies on our website pages, the social network concerned is informed that you have consulted one or more pages on our website. If you are connected to a social network when you visit our site, this is capable of attributing your visit to our site with your account with them. Should you interact with the plugins, by clicking on the "Like" button for example, or by commenting, the corresponding information is sent directly by your internet browser to the social network and recorded on their servers. To understand the purpose and extent of the collection and processing of data by the social networks of which you are a member, as well as your rights in this regard and the settings options of your account so that you can protect your private life, we advise you to consult their privacy policy.
terms.rightsText: On the basis of applicable laws, including GDPR to which certain rights are extended to Swiss residents, you have the following right: Right to information, right of access to data, right of rectification of your data, right to be forgotten, right to limitation of data processing, right to data portability and right to object to data processing.
